post.description: Emails a one-time code to the account address. Only for password-less (Google-only) accounts; password accounts confirm deletion with their password.

message.example: A confirmation code has been sent to your email.

409.description: Account has a password and must confirm with it

get.description: Returns user profile data with aggregated gameplay statistics.

delete.description: Erases the account and its data. Requires 'password' for password accounts or 'code' (one-time, emailed) for password-less accounts. Consent records are kept in anonymized form.

get.summary: List accounts holding unlimited access without paying
get.description: Accounts on the paid Unlimited tier are absent: they are customers, not exemptions, and both play without limits, so this listing is the only place the difference is visible.

post.description: Re-granting to an account that is already exempt replaces the whole row rather than adding one: reason, note, grantor and date are all restated. A note omitted from the request is therefore cleared.

409.description: The account holds a subscription that still grants a tier

post.summary: Submit a completed attempt for a level
post.description: Validates and scores the player's submission for the given game and level, stores the result, and returns the game-specific response. The request body and response shape depend on the game.

200.description: Scored result (shape depends on the game)

400.description: Service misconfiguration for the game prefix

403.description: Consent not current, daily completion allowance spent, or the level was not opened today

post.description: Creates an account, records acceptance of the current legal documents, and returns a Bearer token.

accepted_terms.description: The 18+/guardian affirmation and acceptance of the legal documents; must be true.

consent_current.description: Always true on registration (consent was just recorded); false elsewhere triggers the consent gate.

consent_declined.description: Always false on registration. Elsewhere, true means the account refused the current versions and is restricted rather than merely unanswered.

422.description: Validation failed (e.g. affirmation not accepted or email taken)

post.description: Verifies credentials and returns a Bearer token plus the account's current-consent status.

consent_current.description: Whether the account accepted the current legal-document versions; false triggers the blocking consent gate.

consent_declined.description: Only meaningful while consent_current is false: true means the account refused the current versions, so the gate renders the restricted state rather than the plain re-consent prompt.

get.description: Returns the current user and whether their legal-document consent is current.

consent_current.description: False for Google signups, legacy accounts, and after a document version bump; triggers the consent gate.

consent_declined.description: Only meaningful while consent_current is false: true means the account refused the current versions, so the gate renders the restricted state rather than the plain re-consent prompt.

post.description: Revokes the current access token only; other sessions stay active.
Records a versioned terms + privacy acceptance for the authenticated user. No-op when consent is already current.

200.description: Consent was already current; nothing recorded

consent_declined.description: Always false here: the acceptance just landed.
Always false here: the acceptance just landed.

post.description: Records a versioned refusal for the authenticated user, leaving the account in a restricted state. Idempotent.

204.description: Refusal recorded, or already on record

get.summary: Get the current tier, both allowances and the tier catalogue
get.description: Called on app bootstrap and after any change to tier or usage. `remaining` is advisory for display — the server is authoritative, so a stale value must never gate the interface; let the request through and read the real answer.

200.description: Successful response with list of games

get.description: Returns the currently effective Terms of Service and Privacy Policy version identifiers.

parameters.description: Game identifier (route-model bound). The controller resolves the game and its table_prefix.

403.description: Consent not current, or the daily start allowance is spent

404.description: Level not found or levels table missing

put.description: Validates the current password, updates it with a new hash, revokes all existing tokens, clears pending password reset tokens, and returns a fresh Bearer token.

equations.description: Facts for the level; present only on the single-level view.

Admin.FindTheWrong.StoreItemRequest.title: Admin Store FindTheWrong Item Request
Admin.FindTheWrong.StoreItemRequest.description: JSON payload for creating a new polygon item under a level.

polygon.description: Ordered list of [x, y] points in 0..1 coordinates. Minimum 3 points.

name.description: Localized item name. All three locales are required (used by TTS).

explanation.description: Optional localized explanation shown after the item is found. Locales are independent — send only those you have.

Admin.FindTheWrong.UpdateItemRequest.title: Admin Update FindTheWrong Item Request
Admin.FindTheWrong.UpdateItemRequest.description: JSON payload for partially updating an item.

polygon.description: Full replacement polygon (no partial merge). Same shape rules as create.

name.description: Locale keys to overwrite. Omitted locales are kept as-is.

FindTheWrong.Item.title: FindTheWrong.Item
FindTheWrong.Item.description: Public-facing polygon item without reveal-after-submit fields

polygon.description: Ordered list of [x, y] vertices in normalized 0..1 coordinates

name_audio_url.description: Absolute URL of the name audio for the current locale

title_audio_url.description: Absolute URL of the title audio for the current locale

image_url.description: Absolute URL of the level image

items_count.description: Number of items on the level (present on list endpoint)

title_audio_url.description: Audio URL for the level title

Entitlement.Limits.title: Daily allowances
Entitlement.Limits.description: null means the counter is not enforced — never a large number, so the client branches on it instead of comparing.

Entitlement.Tier.title: Catalogue entry
Entitlement.Tier.description: Carries no display name: the client keys into its own billing translations by `key`.

price_minor.description: Monthly price in the payload's currency, minor units, net of VAT.

current_period_end.description: End of the paid period. Only an active subscription renews on it — for the other statuses this is when access ends, or already ended.

pending_tier.description: Set only while a downgrade is queued. It takes effect at current_period_end.

manage_url.description: The provider's billing portal. Null until a real purchase exists.

tier.description: `unlimited` for an exempt account too — they play identically.

is_exempt.description: Unlimited granted without payment. Suppresses every purchase entry point.

resets_at.description: UTC. Rendering it in the viewer's time is the client's job.

currency.description: One currency covers every price, so it sits beside the catalogue rather than inside each entry.

tiers.description: The whole catalogue in ladder order. The client holds no copy of allowances or prices.

Admin.RegenerateAudioRequest.title: Admin Regenerate Audio Request
Admin.RegenerateAudioRequest.description: Selects which audio field and locale to regenerate.

note.description: Omitted on a re-grant, this clears the existing note.

Admin.StoreLevelRequest.title: Admin Store Level Request
Admin.StoreLevelRequest.description: Multipart/form-data payload for creating a new game level.

title.description: Localized level title. All three locales are required.

text.description: Localized body text (TrueFalseText only; required there).

image.description: Cover image (jpeg/png/webp, max 10 MB). Required except for TrueFalseText.

Admin.UpdateLevelRequest.title: Admin Update Level Request
Admin.UpdateLevelRequest.description: Multipart/form-data payload for updating an existing game level. Send via POST with _method=PATCH so the file part survives Laravel's form-method spoofing.

title.description: Localized level title. All three locales are required.

text.description: Localized body text (TrueFalseText only; required there).

image.description: Optional replacement cover image (jpeg/png/webp, max 10 MB). Omit to keep the existing one.

granted_by.description: Null once the granting admin's own account is deleted; the grant itself survives.

Admin.Statement.title: Admin Statement
Admin.Statement.description: Admin-side true/false statement with localized text and per-locale audio status.

LevelDescription.title: LevelDescription
LevelDescription.description: Level summary for the player level grid

progress.description: Player's progress from their most recent attempt on this level

has_password.description: False for Google-only accounts; the client uses it to choose the account-deletion confirmation UI.

description.example: Find the incorrect statement among the options.

categories.description: Learning areas the game belongs to (a game may have several).

ValidationErrorResponse.description: Returned on 422 when request validation fails.

errors.description: Map of field name to the list of its validation messages.

duration_seconds: The duration seconds field is required.

DailyLimitReachedResponse.description: 403 on either gate once that gate's own daily counter is spent.

message.description: Follows limit_kind: the two gates carry their own text.
message.example: You have already opened every level available today

details.description: limit_kind names the counter this gate enforces: started on opening, completed on submitting.

ConsentRequiredResponse.description: 403 while the account has not accepted the document versions in force — whether it refused them or never answered. Not a limit: no counter moved and nothing resets. The client sends the account to the consent gate.

message.example: Accept the current legal documents to keep playing

LevelNotOpenedTodayResponse.description: 403 on submitting a level with no recorded open for today — either it was never opened, or the open expired at midnight. Not a limit: the client re-fetches the level and resubmits. A 404 on that re-fetch means the level is gone and the attempt cannot be recorded.
